free_tier.stated: Free-marked sites allow up to 3 links a day without an account, or 5 a day once the account's email address is confirmed. Unused links do not carry over to the next day.
free_tier.notes: Premium-only sites are excluded from the free allowance entirely, so the effective host coverage on the free tier is whatever the supported-sites page marks Free.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a URL is unlocked, nothing is stored. The FAQ says 'Supported file sizes depend on the source site, file type and processing required. Very large files or lengthy conversions may fail or take longer to prepare.'
per_object_cap.notes: No numeric object cap is published.

retention.stated: Generated links are temporary. (FAQ: 'Generated links are temporary. Try generating a fresh link and check that the original content is still available')
retention.notes: No link lifetime is published in hours.

egress.terms: Download is served direct from the source site after the link is generated. The plan page promises 'Unlimited link generation' on Premium; no byte allowance is published on either tier.
egress.free_allowance: 3 links/day on Free-marked sites, per public IP

interface_detail: Web generator plus direct HTTP links that can be pasted into any download manager. No public API is documented on the pages read.
tooling: Any HTTP download manager (JDownloader, aria2, curl) once a direct link is generated. No rclone backend and no CLI.
chaining: Cheapest per-month route among debrid providers at EUR 3.00/month on the annual plan, but its 3-links-per-day free tier and per-IP sharing make it a fallback rather than a first choice next to a host-specific path.

limits_note: The supported-sites page runs past 1,000 entries and mixes cloud drives, social video and file hosts; the free/Premium split is per-site and was not enumerated.
binding_note: 3 links a day is 90 a month, so 1 TiB would need an 11.4 GiB average per link, and the per-public-IP sharing means a second device or a household NAT spends the same allowance.

identity_cost.detail: Free generation needs no account. Premium is a Stripe checkout (card, giropay, EPS, P24); the account itself needs only an email and password.

reliability_note: File lockers such as Rapidgator, Turbobit and Katfile are not supported and Premium does not add them; generated links are temporary and unused free links do not carry over.
confidence_note: The free allowance and the price ladder are both quoted from the vendor's own pages. The per-site Free/Premium split and the absence of a byte cap are unverified.

notes: Sub-USD-5 on the annual and quarterly terms, above it monthly (EUR 4.99 = USD 5.60). The site is a multi-site downloader as much as a multi-hoster: much of its 1,000-entry list is social and cloud sources that need no premium account, which inflates the host count a reader might take at face value. Merged from pricing-history: A 2026 rebuild: three auto-renewing plans where the site previously sold nothing it published. The annual at EUR 35.99 (EUR 3.00/month) is the cheapest per-month paid debrid in the set, and the free 3-link day survived the rebuild, which is the opposite of what AllDebrid did in the same window. Merged from payment-rails: Grouped as local-voucher, not as card-only, because a Neosurf cash code is a real cardless route; the verdict still carries a caveat because Neosurf availability is a country question this lane did not resolve, and the local Stripe methods (giropay, EPS, P24) are bank-funded and therefore do not help an account without a bank. Rule used across this lane: identity_cost.kind describes the vendor's own gate, verdict describes the reachable route including a reseller or a cash code. Merged from ladder-verify: The ladder's identity column ('email') is the right conservative reading and its 150 GB row is unaffected. What changes is the earlier record's claim of anonymous free generation: the pages read today neither state it nor offer a guest path, so it should not be repeated as fact. The reset sentence, by contrast, is a genuine find and is the model the other steps lack.
